title: Weak Schur number WS(7), lower bound
statement: Colour 1, 2, ..., n with 7 colours so that no colour holds a solution of x + y = z with x != y, with n as large as possible; it shows WS(7) >= n. The best known lower bound is WS(7) >= 2154, by Quantavane (8 Nov 2026); a colouring of 1..2155 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the colours of 1..n in order, digits 0..6 (whitespace ignored).
score: n, the length of the colouring; it proves WS(7) >= n (larger is better)

best_known.source: WS(7) >= 2154: Canli (Quantavane), 8 Nov 2026, Rowley's construction WS(k+1) >= 4 S(k) + 2 applied to McKenna's S(6) >= 538 partition; certificate verified and merged by Leaps in Bounds (pull request #50, commit 98bda6e, 9 Nov 2026), whose table of published values still shows 2146 (Rowley 2020); read 9 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: Leaps in Bounds, Schur and weak Schur numbers

quantavane_note: our partition is the best known; Leaps in Bounds verified and holds the certificate
